mission_09: Fantastic! You have implemented GraphRNN, a powerful autoregressive model for graph generation. By decomposing graph generation into a sequence of node and edge predictions, your model can learn complex structural patterns from training data. The BFS ordering ensures consistent generation order, while the two-level RNN architecture captures both global graph structure and local edge patterns. The symmetric adjacency matrix enforcement ensures valid undirected graphs. This approach has been successfully applied to molecular graph generation for drug discovery, network topology synthesis, and creating realistic benchmark graphs for algorithm testing.
